$comment: Risk class of every manifest v2 scope (plans/cmux-next/app-platform.md 12.5). One table for the validator, the supervisor's consent sheet and the store. Rules apply in order; the first match wins.

classes.standard: Granted with the app; listed in Settings and revocable.
classes.sensitive: Shown highlighted on the consent sheet; revocable.
classes.restricted: First-party apps, or Verified apps whose review covers this scope. Unverified apps never hold it.

rules.$comment: create and revoke credentials of the family, for example coderouter:keys
